name: Motoo Kimura

summary: Population geneticist who supervised Kimura as a graduate student at University of Wisconsin.

summary: Population geneticist at University of Wisconsin who worked with Kimura.

summary: Population geneticist whose work Kimura built upon and compared against.

name: Haldane
summary: Population geneticist mentioned as part of the famous trio with Fisher and Wright.

name: Moran
summary: Researcher who introduced the Kolmogorov backward equation at the same time as Kimura.

summary: Author of this obituary, from Department of Biology, University of Pennsylvania.

summary: Author of the editorial note, from The Australian National University.
